title: Academic genealogy of Hossein Hafezi
status: Research and diagrams implemented in the static genealogy.html webpage.
scope: All 36 people and their branches in Joseph Bonneau’s supplied image, with Hossein, Martin Kleppmann, Alastair Beresford and Frank Stajano added. Andy Hopper is excluded at Hossein’s explicit request.
notes: Historical links include mathematical tutors, research teachers and a medical apprenticeship. They must not all be called doctoral supervision.
Degree years omitted because the source diagram has several dates that do not consistently represent doctorates.
Main labels use supervisor for Beresford → Kleppmann, per Hossein’s clarification.
The original diagram’s side branches are retained. Stajano’s 2025 article chooses a route through Maxwell, who is not in the supplied image, so Maxwell is not silently substituted.
Do not add the Andy Hopper branch: explicitly excluded by Hossein.

An older Anderson homepage skips Wheeler in describing Needham’s supervision. The supplied diagram, Stajano’s genealogy, the individual biographies, and Cambridge oral-history evidence support Wilkes → Wheeler → Needham; that fuller chain is retained.

Portrait index and credits distinguish research-reference images from images whose reuse license is verified. Needham and Ratcliffe’s Wikipedia lead images are fair-use references; modern Cambridge/Bonneau portraits have no image-specific reuse license stated on their profile pages.
